snapshot.title: Alexandria - Breathable Nail Polish
snapshot.description:
This pink beige shade is inspired by the Egyptian city of Alexandria, also referred to as the "Pearl of the Mediterranean.".

Alexandria is a delicate, light pink beige. This color is more pink than Dakar, but more nude than Komodo.
snapshot.pdp_how_to_use_raw: For water permeability, apply 1-2 thin coats. To extend polish longevity, prep the nail by shaping and buffing before application. Enhance nail health by finishing with our Almond & Ginseng Cuticle Oil .

pdp_faq_items.question: How long before I get my order?
pdp_faq_items.answer: You can expect to have your package in 4-7 business days once shipped in the United States & Canada.

pdp_faq_items.question: Where are 786 polishes made?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

pdp_faq_items.question: How can I ensure water permeability?
pdp_faq_items.answer: To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.

pdp_faq_items.question: How can I ensure water permeability?
pdp_faq_items.answer: To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.

snapshot.title: Cusco - Breathable Nail Polish
snapshot.description: This deep mauve pink is inspired by the stunning rainbow mountain of Cusco, Peru. Known as Vinicunca, or the mountain of seven colors, the mountain is considered a holy site in Peru. Cusco is the former capital city of the Incas, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and the oldest continuously inhabited city in the Americas. Cusco is a deep mauve pink cream. Cusco is darker and cooler than Jaipur and less bright compared to Monduli.

Known as Vinicunca, or the mountain of seven colors, the mountain is considered a holy site in Peru. Cusco is the former capital city of the Incas, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and the oldest continuously inhabited city in the Americas. Cusco is a deep mauve pink cream. Cusco is darker and cooler than Jaipur and less bright compared to Monduli.

pdp_faq_items.question: How long before I get my order?
pdp_faq_items.answer: You can expect to have your package in 4-7 business days once shipped in the United States & Canada.

pdp_faq_items.question: Where are 786 polishes made?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

pdp_faq_items.question: How can I ensure water permeability?
pdp_faq_items.answer: To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.

snapshot.title: Guanajuato - Breathable Nail Polish
snapshot.description:
This beautiful red shade was inspired by the Mexican city of Guanajuato, also called the land of legends, known for its rich history, fascinating legends, and colorful buildings. The most famous alley is the Callejón del Beso or Alley of the Kiss. Located on the slopes of a hill in a neighborhood that dates back to the 18th century, the legend says that couples who kiss on the third step (painted in red) are guaranteed seven years of happiness together.

This color is best described as a dark deep red.

This beautiful red shade was inspired by the Mexican city of Guanajuato, also called the land of legends, known for its rich history, fascinating legends, and colorful buildings. The most famous alley is the Callejón del Beso or Alley of the Kiss. Located on the slopes of a hill in a neighborhood that dates back to the 18th century, the legend says that couples who kiss on the third step (painted in red) are guaranteed seven years of happiness together.

This color is best described as a dark deep red.

pdp_faq_items.question: How long before I get my order?
pdp_faq_items.answer: You can expect to have your package in 4-7 business days once shipped in the United States & Canada.

pdp_faq_items.question: Where are 786 polishes made?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

pdp_faq_items.question: How can I ensure water permeability?
pdp_faq_items.answer: To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.

pdp_faq_items.question: How long before I get my order?
pdp_faq_items.answer: You can expect to have your package in 4-7 business days once shipped in the United States & Canada.

pdp_faq_items.question: Where are 786 polishes made?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

pdp_faq_items.question: How can I ensure water permeability?
pdp_faq_items.answer: To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?

snapshot.title: Lisbon - Breathable Nail Polish
snapshot.description:
This light, cool baby pink is inspired by the beautiful Portuguese city, Lisbon. One of the oldest cities in Europe, it is renowned for its historical landmarks, world-class museums, and beautiful landscape. This breathable nail polish color is inspired by the pink-toned buildings and homes found across Lisbon and the Pink Street, Rua Cor-de-Rosa, the famous nightlife area of the city

Lisbon is best described as a light, cool baby pink sheer nail polish. Lisbon is slightly more purple toned than Petra.

pdp_faq_items.question: How long before I get my order?
pdp_faq_items.answer: You can expect to have your package in 4-7 business days once shipped in the United States & Canada.

pdp_faq_items.question: Where are 786 polishes made?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

pdp_faq_items.question: How can I ensure water permeability?
pdp_faq_items.answer: To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.

pdp_faq_items.question: How long before I get my order?
pdp_faq_items.answer: You can expect to have your package in 4-7 business days once shipped in the United States & Canada.

pdp_faq_items.question: Where are 786 polishes made?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

pdp_faq_items.question: How can I ensure water permeability?
pdp_faq_items.answer: To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.

snapshot.title: Nizwa - Breathable Nail Polish
snapshot.description:
Nizwa is inspired by the beautifully fragrant rose gardens of Oman's Jebel Akhdar, or "green mountain" which is located in the city of Nizwa. Every spring, these gardens are filled with vibrant pink roses that are transformed into the famous Omani rose water. This rose water is used for celebratory, culinary or medicinal purposes.

Nizwa (niz-wah) is best described as a bold, bubblegum pink shade.
snapshot.pdp_how_to_use_raw: For water permeability, apply 1-2 thin coats. To extend polish longevity, prep the nail by shaping and buffing before application. Enhance nail health by finishing with our Almond & Ginseng Cuticle Oil .

pdp_faq_items.question: How long before I get my order?
pdp_faq_items.answer: You can expect to have your package in 4-7 business days once shipped in the United States & Canada.

pdp_faq_items.question: Where are 786 polishes made?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

pdp_faq_items.question: How can I ensure water permeability?
pdp_faq_items.answer: To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.

Nizwa is inspired by the beautifully fragrant rose gardens of Oman's Jebel Akhdar, or "green mountain" which is located in the city of Nizwa. Every spring, these gardens are filled with vibrant pink roses that are transformed into the famous Omani rose water. This rose water is used for celebratory, culinary or medicinal purposes. Nizwa (niz-wah) is best described as a bold, bubblegum pink shade.

pdp_faq_items.question: How long before I get my order?
pdp_faq_items.answer: You can expect to have your package in 4-7 business days once shipped in the United States & Canada.

pdp_faq_items.question: Where are 786 polishes made?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

pdp_faq_items.question: How can I ensure water permeability?
pdp_faq_items.answer: To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.

snapshot.title: Rotomahana - Breathable Nail Polish
snapshot.description: Rotomahana's iridescent light white-pink color is named after Lake Rotomahana in New Zealand, and inspired by the pink and white terraces, also known as Te Otukapuarangi - Maori for the fountain of the clouded sky. This natural wonder was once considered the largest silica sinter deposit in the world and was sometimes referred to as the 8th wonder of the world in the 1800s. In 1886, Mount Tarawera erupted and the terraces were thought to have been destroyed. Rotomahana is an almost-iridescent light pink breathable nail polish.
snapshot.pdp_how_to_use_raw: For water permeability, apply 1-2 thin coats. To extend polish longevity, prep the nail by shaping and buffing before application. Enhance nail health by finishing with our Almond & Ginseng Cuticle Oil .

pdp_faq_items.question: How long before I get my order?
pdp_faq_items.answer: You can expect to have your package in 4-7 business days once shipped in the United States & Canada.

pdp_faq_items.question: Where are 786 polishes made?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

pdp_faq_items.question: How can I ensure water permeability?
pdp_faq_items.answer: To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.

recall.retrieval_body:
Rotomahana's iridescent light white-pink color is named after Lake Rotomahana in New Zealand, and inspired by the pink and white terraces, also known as Te Otukapuarangi - Maori for the fountain of the clouded sky. This natural wonder was once considered the largest silica sinter deposit in the world and was sometimes referred to as the 8th wonder of the world in the 1800s. In 1886, Mount Tarawera erupted and the terraces were thought to have been destroyed. Rotomahana is an almost-iridescent light pink breathable nail polish.

snapshot.title: Sakura - Breathable Nail Polish
snapshot.description:
Sakura [saa-kur-uh] is inspired by the stunning pale pink cherry blossoms found in Sakura, Japan. In fact, the most common of all the cherry blossoms are called "Sakura" or Japanese Cherry. Located in Chiba prefecture, Sakura has been inhabited since prehistory and is home to the National Museum of Japanese History. Sakura blossoms are seen as a symbol of renewal, rebirth and new beginnings. Sakura blossoms only bloom for a brief time - best viewed during Spring time in Japan.

Sakura is best described as a muted pink nude, nearly opaque with two coats.

pdp_faq_items.question: Where are 786 polishes made?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

pdp_faq_items.question: How can I ensure water permeability?
pdp_faq_items.answer: To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.

pdp_details_sections.heading: Overview
pdp_details_sections.body: Our quick-drying top coat clear breathable nail polish provides both a protective seal over your color to prevent chipping and a glossy finished look to your nails.

pdp_details_sections.heading: How to Use
pdp_details_sections.body: For water permeability, apply 1-2 thin coats. To extend polish longevity, prep the nail by shaping and buffing before application. Enhance nail health by finishing with our Almond & Ginseng Cuticle Oil .

pdp_details_sections.heading: Details
pdp_details_sections.body:
Halal certified and wudu-friendly , our innovative formula allows water permeation, providing a solution for those seeking breathable nail products.
Our nail polishes boast a 21-free, non-toxic, plant-based formula, ensuring a safe and eco-friendly beauty experience
Express yourself freely with our nail polish, crafted to be inclusive and welcoming to individuals of all ethical and spiritual backgrounds

pdp_faq_items.question: How long before I get my order?
pdp_faq_items.answer: You can expect to have your package in 4-7 business days once shipped in the United States & Canada.

pdp_faq_items.question: Where are 786 polishes made?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

pdp_faq_items.question: How can I ensure water permeability?
pdp_faq_items.answer: To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.
